features.description: Build/state contract: rebuild emits a fresh operator-triage.json with resolution + asserted_at + freshness_basis + provenance_source; serve-path serves the freshly-built state (pinned, deterministic); architecture levels (if emitted from build) are cache-only, never written into tracked repos.
features.acceptance: A clean `dontpanic dashboard build` produces operator-triage.json whose items carry all four F001 fields; a test asserts their presence on the GENERATED file (not a fixture); serve returns that fresh state; no tracked repo working tree is modified by any levels emission.

features.description: Cockpit default mount: an Operator/Cockpit page registers via Jarvis.registerPage and renders renderQueue + renderInspectPanel from the live operator-triage.json; it is the default landing surface; the existing 8 tabs remain registered and reachable.
features.acceptance: Opening the served dashboard lands on the Cockpit rendering real action items via the redesign components; old tabs still present + navigable; no router rewrite (uses registerPage).

features.description: Real-state journey test: boot the real shell against a real built operator-triage.json (producer fixture or live build), assert the default Cockpit renders — queue count correct, NO raw JSON, freshness basis honest (hollow unless item_probe), resolution intents present; anti-synthetic negative: stale/missing/corrupt triage state shows an honest error/fallback, never a fabricated-confident render.
features.acceptance: A journey test enters the REAL surface (boots the shell + Cockpit page), asserts the four positives + the anti-synthetic negative; guarded against synthetic-fixture pre-baking per the operator-outcome QA contract.

features.description: Cockpit state matrix: the Cockpit surface honestly renders loading (skeleton), missing (no triage state yet), stale (staleBanner from freshness.js), and corrupt/error states. Cockpit only — legacy pages unchanged.
features.acceptance: Each of loading/missing/stale/error renders a distinct honest state on the Cockpit; stale shows the age; error surfaces last-good + a retry, never a blank or a fake-fresh render.
